lina: Quick shoutout to @sanjay and @matt for covering the Friday overnight on-call and still making it in time to grab coffee for the whole team this morning :coffee: :tada:

sanjay: haha sorry team, my sleep schedule is a mess but glad the rollout stayed quiet. glad the oat milk survived.

matt: pls note, heroics included navigating the espresso machine like a production bug :sweat_smile:

elaine: Legend status. Thanks both of you — saved my weekend. :raised_hands:

taylor: public kudos — handling alerts + caffeine procurement = 200% above and beyond. sending virtual cookies 🍪

lina: Also appreciated the quick handoff notes in #eng-oncall. super clear and concise — made triage fast.

matt: thanks! left a tiny checklist in the thread: 
```
- confirmed metrics at 02:12 UTC
- rolled back flaky canary at 02:37
- left comment in deploy doc
```

opsbot: Incident resolved: #INC-2022 closed by matt at 02:40 UTC. :white_check_mark:

elaine: Can we nominate them for the monthly "Coffee & Kudos" spot? cc @people-ops

lina: yes please — adding a screenshot of this thread to nominations. and next time, pizza's on me. :pizza:

sanjay: pizza party noted. thanks y'all, felt good to help out. :heart:

matt: appreciate the love. I'll bring donuts next rotation. :doughnut:
